description: Travel Speed for Main Road Corridors of Greater Hobart is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Tasmania Government's The List Data. Greater Hobart Travel Speed dataset describes various factors including congestion during AM Inbound and PM outbound peaks for five main road corridors with a origin/destination of Hobart City Centre. Coverage: Greater Hobart. The portal files it under the publisher Tasmania Government's The List Data. Its tags are TRANSPORTATION-Land. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
